scripts.quill:copy: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); const d=path.join('node_modules/quill/dist'); const out=path.join('public/vendor/quill'); fs.mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync(path.join(d,'quill.js'),path.join(out,'quill.js')); fs.copyFileSync(path.join(d,'quill.snow.css'),path.join(out,'quill.snow.css')); console.log('Quill copied to public/vendor/quill');"
